questions.text: Integers are drawn uniformly at random from 1 to 2,918,712, with replacement, until some value appears for the second time. What is the expected number of draws, counting the repeat?

Two points are chosen independently and uniformly at random in a 1 × 1.69 rectangle. What is the expected distance between them? (Settled by averaging 400,000 random pairs.)
